Register of Licensed Sponsors

Worker & Temporary Worker routes · Snapshot: 21 Aug 2026 · — organisations on file
Source: gov.uk Register of licensed sponsors: workers. This is a static snapshot — always re-verify a specific sponsor's live status on gov.uk before relying on it for a visa application or offer. Being listed means an organisation can sponsor — not that a role is currently open. The register has no official industry field, so the Sector filter matches keywords in the company name only (e.g. "hotel", "software") — it will miss relevantly-named companies and can include false positives. Treat it as a shortlist starting point, not a definitive sector list.
